```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidypopgen)
library(tidygenclust)
library(resrepo)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(gridExtra)

# Set cores
n_cores <- 15
data.table::setDTthreads(n_cores)
bigparallelr::set_blas_ncores(n_cores)
```

```{r set-directories}
res_dir <- "../results/s05_admixture/"
```

This script uses ADMIXTURE @alexanderFastModelbasedEstimation2009 through the package tidypopgen @carterTidypopgenTidyPopulation2026, and clumppling @liuClumpplingClusterMatching2024 through the package tidygenclust @tysallTidygenclustClusteringPopulation2025 to estimate ancestry proportions of individuals in the global dataset. 

# Load gt

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <-
  gt_load("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_neo_clean_ld.gt",
    reattach_to = "../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_neo_clean_ld"
  )
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% group_by(population)
```

```{r}
gt_as_plink(mad_bor_g1000_sum, "../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_neo_clean_ld.bed")
```


# Loci and sample count

```{r}
nrow(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
count_loci(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
```

ADMIXTURE was run on the full, cleaned dataset of `r nrow(mad_bor_g1000_sum)` individuals and `r count_loci(mad_bor_g1000_sum)` SNPs.

```{r}
if (file.exists("../data/intermediate/admixture/unsupervised/admixture_m.RDS")) {
  qmats <-
    readRDS("../data/intermediate/admixture/unsupervised/admixture_m.RDS")
} else {
  tictoc::tic()
  k <- c(2:10)
  qmats <- gt_admixture(mad_bor_g1000_sum,
    k,
    n_runs = 25,
    crossval = TRUE,
    seed = c(1:25),
    n_cores = n_cores
  )
  saveRDS(qmats, "../data/intermediate/admixture/unsupervised/admixture_m.RDS")
  time <- tictoc::toc()
}
```

ADMIXTURE was run unsupervised for k values `min(range(unique(qmats$k)))` to `r max(range(unique(qmats$k)))`, with `r rle(qmats$k)$lengths[1]` repeats. 

```{r}
qmats <- readRDS("../data/intermediate/admixture/unsupervised/admixture_m.RDS")
```

```{r}
# check order
testthat::expect_equal(qmats$id, mad_bor_g1000_sum$id)
testthat::expect_equal(qmats$group, mad_bor_g1000_sum$population)
```

# Reorder gen_tibble

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region <- "Other"
mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population %in% c("Borneo", "Sumba", "Timor"), "Region"] <- "Island southeast Asia"
mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population %in% c("BEB", "PJL"), "Region"] <- "South Asia"
mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population %in% c("CHS", "KHV"), "Region"] <- "East Asia"
# Not really happy about grouping all African samples here though...
mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population %in% c("ESN", "GWD", "LWK", "MSL", "YRI"), "Region"] <- "Africa"
mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population %in% c("Betsimisaraka", "Merina", "Diego", "Sakalava_Tsimihety", "Betsileo", "Vezo", "Mikea", "Temoro"), "Region"] <- "Malagasy"
# wharerver is left as "Other" set to Africa
mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region == "Other", "Region"] <- "Africa"

mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% arrange(Region, population)
```

# Reorder qmats according to population order in mad_bor_g1000_sum

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% filter(.data$id %in% qmats$id)

mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum[match(qmats$id, mad_bor_g1000_sum$id), ]

region <- mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region
region <- factor(region, levels = unique(mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region))

qmats <- gt_admix_reorder_q(qmats, group = region)
```

# Replot with labels at the top

```{r}
group <- qmats$group
group_x <- cumsum(table(tidypopgen:::fct_inorder_base(group)))

segment_data <- data.frame(
    x = group_x + 0.5,
    xend = group_x + 0.5,
    y = rep(0, length(group_x)),
    yend = rep(1, length(group_x))
  )

get_mid_points <- function(vec) {
  (vec[-length(vec)] + vec[-1L]) / 2.
}

q_tbl <- as.data.frame(get_q_matrix(qmats, k = 2, run = 1))
q_tbl$id <- attr(get_q_matrix(qmats, k = 2, run = 1), "id")
q_tbl$group <-
        rep(
          attr(get_q_matrix(qmats, k = 2, run = 1), "group"),
          each = nrow(q_tbl) / length(attr(get_q_matrix(qmats, k = 2, run = 1), "group"))
        )
q_tbl$id <- seq_len(nrow(q_tbl))
q_tbl <- q_tbl %>%
        dplyr::arrange(.data$group, .data$id)
q_tbl$id <- seq_len(nrow(q_tbl))
  q_tbl <- q_tbl %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = dplyr::starts_with(".Q"),
      names_to = "q",
      values_to = "percentage"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(percentage = as.numeric(.data$percentage))
q_tbl <- q_tbl %>%
      dplyr::group_by(.data$group, .data$id) %>%
      # only sort by group, so that we don't reorder individuals within groups
      dplyr::arrange(.data$group) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        q = factor(
          .data$q,
          levels = .data$q[order(.data$percentage, decreasing = FALSE)]
        )
      )
    dominant_q <- q_tbl %>%
      dplyr::group_by(.data$id) %>%
      dplyr::summarize(dominant_q = max(.data$percentage), .groups = "drop")

    q_tbl <- q_tbl %>%
      dplyr::left_join(dominant_q, by = "id")

    q_tbl <- q_tbl %>%
      dplyr::group_by(.data$group) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(desc(.data$dominant_q), .by_group = TRUE)

  levels_q <- unique(q_tbl$id)
  q_tbl <- q_tbl %>%
    dplyr::mutate(id = factor(.data$id, levels = levels_q))


plot_a <- plot_a + 
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
      data = segment_data,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = .data$x,
        y = .data$y,
        xend = .data$xend,
        yend = .data$yend
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(
    breaks = unique(q_tbl$id)[get_mid_points(c(0, group_x))],
    labels = names(group_x),
    position = "top"
  )  +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 0)
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x.top = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text.x.bottom = element_blank())
```


```{r}
q_mat2 <- get_q_matrix(qmats, k = 2, run = 1)

q_tbl <- tidy(q_mat2, mad_bor_g1000_sum)

group <- as.character(qmats$group)
group_x <- cumsum(table(tidypopgen:::fct_inorder_base(group)))

q_tbl <- q_tbl %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$group, .data$id) %>%
  # only sort by group, so that we don't reorder individuals within groups
  dplyr::arrange(.data$group) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    q = factor(
      .data$q,
      levels = .data$q[order(.data$percentage, decreasing = FALSE)]
    )
  ) # nolint

dominant_q <- q_tbl %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$id) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(dominant_q = max(.data$percentage), .groups = "drop")

q_tbl <- q_tbl %>%
  dplyr::left_join(dominant_q, by = "id")

q_tbl <- q_tbl %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.data$group) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(.data$dominant_q), .by_group = TRUE)
levels_q <- unique(q_tbl$id)
q_tbl <- q_tbl %>%
  dplyr::mutate(id = factor(.data$id, levels = levels_q))


plt <- ggplot2::ggplot(

# add vertical lines if we have groups
segment_data <- data.frame(
  x = group_x + 0.5,
  xend = group_x + 0.5,
  y = rep(0, length(group_x)),
  yend = rep(1, length(group_x))
)

plt <- plt +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    data = segment_data,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = .data$x,
      y = .data$y,
      xend = .data$xend,
      yend = .data$yend
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  )

get_mid_points <- function(vec) {
  (vec[-length(vec)] + vec[-1L]) / 2.
}
plt <- plt +
  ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(
    breaks = get_mid_points(c(0, group_x)),
    labels = names(group_x),
    position = "top"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 0)
  )
plt
```

```{r}
# find samples of interest within gt_admix object `qmats`
malagasy_index <- which(qmats$group %in% c(
  "Betsimisaraka", "Merina", "Diego Mixed",
  "Sakalava/Tsimihety", "Betsileo",
  "Vezo", "Mikea", "Temoro"
))

# subset gt_admix object `qmats` to only include samples of interest
gt_admix_subset <- function(qmats, index) {
  qmats_subset <- qmats
  # k doesn't change
  # CV doesn't change
  # loglik doesn't change
  # algorithm doesn't change
  # attributes don't change

  # subset id
  qmats_subset$id <- qmats_subset$id[index]
  # subset group
  qmats_subset$group <- qmats_subset$group[index]
  # reset the levels of group
  qmats_subset$group <- factor(qmats_subset$group, levels = unique(qmats_subset$group))

  # subset Q
  for (i in seq_along(qmats$k)) {
    qmats_subset$Q[[i]] <- qmats$Q[[i]][index, ]
    # add an id attribute
    attr(qmats_subset$Q[[i]], "id") <- qmats_subset$id
    # add a group attribute
    attr(qmats_subset$Q[[i]], "group") <- qmats_subset$group
  }

  # subset P
  for (i in seq_along(qmats$k)) {
    qmats_subset$P[[i]] <- qmats$P[[i]]
    # add an id attribute
    attr(qmats_subset$P[[i]], "id") <- qmats_subset$id
    # add a group attribute
    attr(qmats_subset$P[[i]], "group") <- qmats_subset$group
  }

  # subset each matrix
  return(qmats_subset)
}

qmats_malagasy <- gt_admix_subset(qmats, malagasy_index)

autoplot(get_q_matrix(qmats_malagasy, k = 6, run = 1),
  annotate_group = TRUE,
  arrange_by_group = TRUE,
  arrange_by_indiv = TRUE,
```

# Check which ancestry components each .Q represents

```{r}
augmented <- augment(get_q_matrix(qmats, k = 2, run = 1),
  data = mad_bor_g1000_sum
)

# filter augmented to $population CHS and print head
augmented_chs <- augmented %>% filter(population == "CHS")
head(augmented_chs) # .Q1 representing Asian ancestry

augmented_gwd <- augmented %>% filter(population == "GWD")
head(augmented_gwd)
```
